'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a male Gladiator NPC training someone from Ragunna, '''Laon'''. They can be found at at the [[Solis Tavern]] in [[Capitoline Hill City]]. 

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(First interaction)
:'''Camilus''' ...You want to become a Gladiator?
:'''Laon''' Th-that's right! Please, sir, can you tell me how to become an outstanding Gladiator?
:'''Camilus''' Hmph... Where you from, kid?
:'''Laon''' F-from Ragunna!
:'''Camilus''' Alright, kid, listen up. If you want to be an outstanding Gladiator, the first step is to eat all of this. C'mon!
:'''Laon''' Eat... these? But it's raw meat!
:'''Camilus''' That's right! If you want to be a great Gladiator like me, you need to be brave enough to eat animals raw!
:'''Laon''' Is this stuff r-really edible...? Alright, alright! I'll eat it!
:'''Rover''' ...
:'''Rover''' Is that really edible...? I'll come back and check later.
----
;(Return to the scene again)
;'''Laon''' No... no "vittles"... That stuff the Echoes make is disgusting. Not for me...
;'''Camilus''' What do you mean "disgusting"...? All the same to me... Here, let's have another drink...
;'''Camilus''' After the drink, we'll train...
;'''Laon''' You still want to train...? You, my friend... are going to be an outstanding Gladiator...
----
;(Day time at Plaza)
:;'''Camilus''' Let's practice that same move again! Try to work up the same courage you had when you swapped all of my food for "vittles!"
:;'''Laon''' That was because you tricked me into eating raw meat. But whatever, bring it on! I'll show you that I'm going to be a great Gladiator!
:;'''Camilus''' Good! That's the spirit!

:'''Laon''' One, two... three! C'mon! Again!
:{{DIcon}} How's training going?
:'''Laon''' Great... Perfect even! As long as I'm not eating raw meat!
:'''Laon''' Mr. Camilus may always play tricks on me, but his teaching is the real deal! I want to continue training!
{{Dialogue End}}
